3. The expansion should happen in the config loading/normalization phase

## Acceptance criteria
- New helper function exists with proper error handling
- All path-typed fields go through tilde expansion on load
- Missing HOME falls back gracefully
- cargo clippy clean (no unwrap/expect in non-test code)
- Paths without leading '~' are unchanged

args.command:
br create --title "Add unit tests for tilde expansion" --description "## Scope
Write comprehensive unit tests for the tilde expansion functionality in src/config/mod.rs.

## What to do
1. Test cases for '~/'.needle' in global config - resolves under HOME
2. Test cases for workspace .needle.yaml with '~/.needle' - resolves under HOME
3. Test cases for env var with tilde paths - resolves under HOME
4. Test bare '~' (no slash) - resolves to HOME
5. Test '~/x' paths - resolves to HOME/x
6. Test paths without tilde - unchanged
7. Test missing HOME environment variable - fallback behavior
8. Test empty string handling

## Acceptance criteria
- All test cases pass
- cargo clippy clean
- Tests cover edge cases (empty string, missing HOME, various tilde forms)
- Tests are in #[cfg(test)] module in src/config/mod.rs
